claims: Netflix has officially renewed The Lincoln Lawyer for a 10-episode fifth season.
Production of The Lincoln Lawyer season 5 begins in Los Angeles in early 2026.
The Lincoln Lawyer season 5 is based on Michael Connelly’s novel Resurrection Walk.
The Lincoln Lawyer season 5 will follow Mickey Haller as he tackles wrongful conviction cases.
The Lincoln Lawyer season 5 will heavily feature storylines from the book Resurrection Walk.
Manuel Garcia-Rulfo returns as Mickey Haller.
Co-showrunner Ted Humphrey announced that filming of The Lincoln Lawyer season 5 began in early 2026.
The Lincoln Lawyer Season 4 began streaming in February 2026.
